title: Fathers With PTSD or Complex Trauma
description: This course supports fathers living with PTSD or complex trauma. It explores how trauma affects emotional regulation, communication, parenting, and relationships. Fathers learn strategies to stay grounded, reduce triggers, and parent safely while managing trauma symptoms.
learningOutcomes: Understand how PTSD and complex trauma affect emotions, behaviour, and parenting.
Recognise personal triggers and trauma responses.
Learn grounding and regulation strategies to stay present with children.
Develop safe communication and parenting practices during stress.

modules.title: Understanding Trauma Responses

modules.title: Parenting While Managing Trauma
modules.content: Covers emotional safety, predictable routines, and child‑centred communication.

modules.title: Grounding and Regulation Skills
modules.content: Provides practical tools for managing triggers, staying present, and reducing conflict.

title: Fathers With Chronic Illness or Disability
description: This course supports fathers living with chronic illness or disability. It explores how physical limitations, fatigue, pain, or disability affect parenting, emotional wellbeing, and family relationships. Fathers learn strategies to parent safely, communicate needs, and build supportive routines.
learningOutcomes: Understand how chronic illness or disability affects parenting and family dynamics.
Recognise the emotional impact of physical limitations on fathers and children.
Learn strategies for safe, consistent, and adaptive parenting.
Develop communication skills to express needs and set healthy boundaries.

modules.content: Covers routines, communication, and child‑centred adjustments.

modules.title: Building Support and Stability
modules.content: Provides tools for seeking support, managing fatigue, and maintaining emotional connection.

Recognise triggers, urges, and patterns that lead to gambling behaviour.
